channel.title: Dev Ledger Blog
channel.description: Writing about GitHub history, code metrics, developer analytics, privacy, and Dev Ledger.

item.title: How to Analyze Programming Language Usage Across GitHub Repositories
item.description: Learn how to read language composition across repositories, distinguish snapshots from trends, and use language history to understand how a developer's stack evolves over time.
item.author: Noaman Ali

item.title: How to Compare GitHub Activity Across 7D, 30D, 90D, YTD, and 1Y
item.description: Choosing the right time range changes what GitHub analytics can tell you. Learn when to use short, medium, and long windows and how to compare them without misleading yourself.
item.author: Noaman Ali

item.title: What Your Git Commit History Can Tell You About How You Work
item.description: Commit history can reveal cadence, focus, project transitions, bursts, gaps, and recurring development patterns — if you treat it as context rather than a productivity score.
item.author: Noaman Ali

item.title: GitHub Analytics: 12 Metrics Worth Tracking and What They Actually Mean
item.description: A practical guide to 12 GitHub analytics metrics — commits, active days, additions, deletions, net growth, churn, languages, repository activity, streaks, milestones, pull requests, and project lifecycle.
item.author: Noaman Ali

item.title: Repository Lifecycle Analytics: Active, Dormant, and Revived GitHub Projects
item.description: Learn how to identify active, dormant, newly started, and revived repositories and use lifecycle patterns to understand how a body of development work changes over time.
item.author: Noaman Ali

item.title: How to Analyze Your GitHub Development History
item.description: A practical way to read commits, source growth, churn, activity patterns, languages, and repository evolution without reducing development work to a single score.
item.author: Noaman Ali

item.title: Developer Productivity Metrics: What to Measure and What to Avoid
item.description: A practical framework for using commits, churn, source growth, active days, repository activity, and milestones without pretending a single metric can measure developer productivity.
item.author: Noaman Ali

item.title: What the GitHub Contribution Graph Doesn't Show
item.description: GitHub's contribution graph is useful for seeing activity over time, but it leaves out code growth, churn, repository lifecycles, language shifts, and much of the context behind development work.
item.author: Noaman Ali

item.title: How to Measure Source Code Growth Over Time
item.description: Learn how to calculate net source growth from additions and deletions, choose meaningful time windows, and interpret codebase growth without equating bigger with better.
item.author: Noaman Ali

item.title: How to Track Developer Activity Without Storing Source Code
item.description: Developer analytics can be built from repository metadata, commit statistics, language counts, timestamps, and repository state without persisting the source code itself.
item.author: Noaman Ali

item.title: What Is Code Churn? How to Read It Without Misusing It
item.description: Code churn measures how much code is added and deleted over a period. Here is how to calculate it, interpret it, and avoid turning it into a misleading productivity score.
item.author: Noaman Ali
